description: List a repository's test-analytics results, optionally filtered by branch, commit, outcome and duration. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/test-results/.

commitId.description: Filter to a commit SHA (maps to `commit_id`).

durationMax.description: Maximum test duration in seconds (maps to `duration_max`).

durationMin.description: Minimum test duration in seconds (maps to `duration_min`).

owner.description: Owner username — the organization or user login on the git service, e.g. 'codecov' (required).

pageSize.description: Number of results per page (maps to `page_size`).

service.description: Git service provider — one of 'github' (default), 'gitlab', 'bitbucket', 'github_enterprise', 'gitlab_enterprise' or 'bitbucket_server'.

name: codecov_list_test_results
title: List test results
